selection_reason: Approved two-column design provides larger hero raster and fewer overlapping interface elements. Earlier three-column concept was inspected but not combined.
method: Deterministic crop and manually traced polygon alpha mask. Supersampled edge alpha; no RGB retouching, synthesis, inpainting, upscaling, or hidden-pixel reconstruction.
limitations: Only one existing hero, Iron Vanguard, is present in these sources. Assets are views of the same hero, not invented additional characters.
Minigun continues beyond the right source frame and remains clipped.
Lower torso is occluded by Abilities panel at source y=572, so cutout has a straight boundary there.
The large weapon silhouette remains visible over the panel; its native lower edge is retained to the available frame extent.
Head and armor crops are intentionally cropped at collar/chest; full shoulders and body are not present in those crops.
Mask is hand-traced, antialiased, and may retain a very thin source-colored fringe. No original edge colors were repainted.

assets.description: Original hero and weapon silhouette; native-size transparent PNG
Head and collar source crop; original opaque background and thin panel border retained
Transparent head and collar crop; flat lower crop boundary
Clean transparent head and chest crop; same original RGB and traced alpha
